Voted “Best Food Truck in Denver” by 5280 Magazine, our hearty bowls will fill you up
without bogging you down. Crock Spot Gourmet Food Trucks and Catering offers the
Denver Metro area slow-cooked goodness. All of our proteins, including our vegetarian &
vegan options, are cooked slowly to mouthwatering perfection, served over healthy grain
varietals and topped with an international sauce of choice.
Our “quick serve” concept makes sure our guests never wait in a long line. Our team can
have a guest served in 25 seconds or less, which makes our cuisine ideal for any time
sensitive event. Our unique concept invites our customers to “choose their own adventure”
when ordering.

Photography
PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
Photography should be fun, bright, and full of color. Subject matter should be food and service
focused and include images of happy customers. Ideally, the hues within the photos should include
touches of the purple, green, red, and gold from the brand palette.
10
Copy standards
EDITORIAL STYLE
• Don’t use quotation marks when quoting song lyrics.
• Pun hard and pun often.
• Use exclamation points to enhance copy. Use sparingly and never
more than one at a time.
• Use all capital letters to emphasize some words as needed. Never
use two all capital words in the same sentence.
TAGLINES/PUNS
Existing
Crock Star

11
messaging
VOICE
• Authentic and approachable
• Warm and inviting
• Fun and friendly
• Simple and conversational
TONE
Crock Spot’s tone is friendly and conversational. Maintain a casual
tone while fitting in “crock” puns wherever possible.
When writing short taglines and sayings, use popular lyrics with
“crock” in place of a word in a rock song.
Ex: We will, we will, CROCK you.
Ex: Let’s give them something to CROCK about.
When describing the food, maintain an informative and fun tone
while describing flavors.
Ex: A fan favorite! Sriracha is an Asian hot sauce made from chili
paste. We mix it with sour cream for a MEDIUM heat sauce.
12
Customer personas
CUSTOMER 1
Kelly is a 39-year-old woman with two kids aged 13 and 9. She
values eateries that allow her and her children to customize their
own meals while still being quick and healthy. Her 13-year-old has a
gluten allergy and she prefers to eat vegan meals whenever possible.
CUSTOMER 2
Josh is a 25-year-old business development representative at
a software start up. He goes out to lunch with coworkers every
weekday and prefers places that have healthier options and a lot
of variety. He’s a busy guy, so he prefers fast casual but is tired of
burritos and pizza all the time.
CUSTOMER 3
Pierce is a 30-year-old barista who loves to travel and try new
things. He prefers healthy options and enjoys trying new foods from
different cultures. He enjoys a fancy dinner but is budget conscious
so he tends to eat at affordable, fast-casual restaurants.

Representation Agreement & Fee Schedule

Welcome ___________________ (“Client”) to The Allies Law Firm (“THE ALLIES”).

We are pleased to represent you. This Client Agreement is a legally binding contract. By signing below, you agree to hire THE ALLIES under the terms outlined in this Agreement and in the Fee Schedule, attached as “Appendix A.” 

Please read this Agreement carefully. If you do not understand any provision, ask before signing. 

The Allies Way 

At THE ALLIES, we do not practice law reactively. We operate through structure, clarity, and accountability.

Most law firms run on personalities. We run on systems. Systems produce consistency. Consistency produces results.

Every engagement follows this framework:

Plan. Every case begins with a clear strategy. We identify your objectives, risks, leverage points, and the most efficient path forward.

Value. Our work must meaningfully advance your outcome. The goal is not activity — it is progress.

Price. You will understand what is included, what is not included, and when fees are earned. Predictability reduces stress and improves decision-making.

Communication. Clear expectations prevent confusion. We communicate about strategy, next steps, and costs before they become surprises.

Action. Results require Action. We do our part. You must do yours.

This structure allows us to deliver high-level legal representation with consistency — not chaos.

Three-Way Wins

We believe the strongest client relationships create alignment. For this engagement to work, three parties must win:

Client Wins. You receive meaningful value, strong representation, and an outcome that justifies the investment you make.

Team Wins. Our team must be able to do great work in a professional, respectful environment where they are fairly compensated and able to make a difference in clients’ lives.

Company Wins. The firm must operate profitably so we can invest in better systems, stronger talent, and long-term stability — which directly benefits you.

When these three remain aligned, service improves, stress decreases, and outcomes strengthen.

We are committed to maintaining this alignment throughout your case.

Your Team 

When you hire THE ALLIES, you are hiring a coordinated legal team — not a single individual. Every case is supported by the collective experience and collaboration of our firm. Your team may include:

Case Manager (Paralegal)

Your primary point of contact. The Case Manager:

Manages communication flow.

Tracks deadlines and case milestones.

Coordinates internal team members.

Ensures your case continues to move forward efficiently.

All routine communication goes through your Case Manager, so you receive faster updates, clearer communication, and consistent follow-through on your case.

Lead Attorney

One attorney will be assigned as the Lead Attorney for your case. The Lead Attorney:

Oversees your case from start to finish.

Develops and approves legal strategy.

Provides legal advice.

Negotiates on your behalf.

Appears in court and at mediation.

The Lead Attorney is responsible for the strategic direction and oversight of your case.

While the Lead Attorney manages your matter, all ALLIES attorneys regularly collaborate. Depending on the stage or complexity of your case, additional attorneys may contribute insight, assist with strategy, or support specific litigation needs, based on their experience and the needs of your case.

This collaborative structure ensures your case benefits from the firm’s collective strength while maintaining clear accountability through one Lead Attorney.

The Lead Attorney is not your daily contact. This is intentional so your attorney can dedicate uninterrupted time to strategy, drafting, negotiation, and courtroom preparation—the work that produces meaningful results. You don’t want your attorney answering messages all day; you want them winning. 

The Allies Team

Beyond your Lead Attorney and Case Manager, your case may involve additional team members as needed.

Our firm operates as a unified system. As your case progresses, team members may shift to ensure the right internal resources are applied at the right time — without disrupting continuity or accountability.

Communication

Clear communication is essential to getting you the best possible outcome.

One of the most common frustrations people have with attorneys is silence. Messages that sit unanswered, uncertainty about what is happening, and not knowing what comes next. We built our communication system to eliminate that frustration.

Because you are working with a coordinated team, not a single individual, we use structured communication to ensure clarity, responsiveness, and momentum throughout your case.

Business Hours

Our regular business hours are:

Monday–Thursday: 9:00 AM to 4:30 PMFriday: By appointment onlySaturday & Sunday: Closed

Messages received outside business hours will be addressed on the next business day.

Client Portal – Required Communication Channel

All routine communication must occur through your secure Client Portal.

When you message through the Client Portal, you are messaging your entire team — not just one person. This ensures:

No message is missed.

The appropriate team member responds.

Communication is documented and organized.

Your case continues moving forward without interruption.

Most responses will come from your Case Manager. Your Case Manager works directly with the Lead Attorney and other team members as needed, gathers the necessary information, and provides you with a clear and organized response.

You will not see your Lead Attorney frequently in the Portal. This is intentional. Your attorney’s primary role is to focus on strategy, drafting, negotiation, mediation, and court appearances — the work that directly advances your case. The Client Portal allows your attorney to stay focused on high-level legal work while ensuring you still receive timely communication.

Response Expectations

Portal messages are reviewed daily during business hours.

Responses may include:

A direct answer,

A request for clarification,

Or notice that the matter has been escalated for attorney review.

If legal advice or strategic analysis is required, your question will be escalated to the Lead Attorney, and you will be informed accordingly.

Phone Calls – By Appointment Only

To protect momentum and preparation quality, we do not accept unscheduled phone calls. Unscheduled calls interrupt legal work, delay progress, and prevent proper preparation. For that reason, calls must be scheduled in advance through the Client Portal.

If you would prefer to speak by phone, Zoom, or in person, you may request a meeting through the Client Portal. We may ask for a brief description of what you would like to discuss so we can prepare and ensure the meeting is productive and focused on solutions.

Unscheduled non-emergency calls may be assessed a $100 administrative fee.

Emergencies

A true emergency involves an immediate threat to life, liberty, or property.

If you are experiencing a physical emergency, call 9-1-1 immediately.

A legal emergency is rare but may include:

Your children are in immediate and irreparable danger.

Law enforcement or DCFS is at your door regarding your case.

In a true legal emergency, you may call our office directly. This is the sole exception to the no-unscheduled-call policy.

The following, while important, are not emergencies and should be directed through the Client Portal:

Parenting-time disputes.

Late pickups or drop-offs.

Notices of relocation.

Scheduling disagreements.

Using the Client Portal ensures your entire team receives the message and can respond appropriately.

Portal Access Issues

If you experience technical difficulties accessing your Client Portal, you may contact our office for assistance or email info@allieslawfirm.com for technical support only.

Mutual Promises

We (the Client and The Allies Law Firm) agree to keep the following promises:

Communication          ______ (initials)

Clear and timely communication is essential to the success of your case. We agree to communicate with you in accordance with the Communication section of this Agreement. You agree to follow the communication structure outlined in this Agreement and to respond promptly when information or decisions are requested.

Failure to communicate in a timely and complete manner may delay your case, increase costs, or limit strategic options.   

Honesty / Integrity          ______ (initials)

We say what we will do, and we do what we say.

THE ALLIES cannot and will not represent a dishonest client. If, at any time during the representation, it becomes clear that you have misrepresented facts, withheld material information, or been untruthful with any member of our team, THE ALLIES may withdraw from representation consistent with the Utah Rules of Professional Conduct.

Likewise, if you believe any member of THE ALLIES has acted dishonestly, you may terminate the attorney-client relationship. Any unearned funds will be handled in accordance with applicable ethical rules.

Attorney–Client Relationship & Privilege          ______ (initials)

All information you share with us regarding your case is confidential and protected by attorney-client privilege.

All members of THE ALLIES team, including those you may not interact with directly, are bound by this confidentiality.

If a third party pays your legal fees, our duty of loyalty and confidentiality remains solely to you. Payment by a third party does not alter our professional obligations under the Utah Rules of Professional Conduct.

Cooperation & Timing          ______ (initials)

Successful representation requires cooperation and timeliness.

You agree to:

Provide complete and accurate information.

Respond to firm inquiries promptly.

Deliver requested documents within the timeframes outlined in this Agreement.

Provide all required information sufficiently in advance of court deadlines to allow proper preparation.

Client-Caused Urgency. If deadlines become compressed due to delayed client responses, incomplete information, or last-minute decisions, accelerated work may be required. Such circumstances may trigger the Emergency Action fee described in Appendix “A.”

Fees          ______ (initials)

Our fees, billing structure, retainers, and payment terms are outlined in the attached Fee Schedule (Appendix “A”), which is incorporated into this Agreement by reference.

By signing this Agreement, you acknowledge that you have reviewed Appendix “A,” understand the fee structure applicable to your matter, and agree to be bound by its terms.

Timely payment is a condition of continued representation. Failure to comply with the payment terms set forth in Appendix “A” may result in paused work, withdrawal from representation, or other remedies permitted by law. 

To the extent permitted by Utah law, you grant THE ALLIES LAW FIRM a lien for unpaid attorney’s fees and costs on any claims, causes of action, settlements, judgments, or awards arising from your case. This lien is intended to secure payment of fees and costs owed under this Agreement and Appendix “A,” consistent with Utah Code Ann. § 38-2-7 and applicable law.

Decision-Making Authority          ______ (initials)

You retain ultimate authority over the objectives of your case, including whether to accept or reject settlement offers, whether to proceed to trial, and other major decisions that materially affect your rights or financial obligations.

THE ALLIES is responsible for determining the legal strategy and the means by which those objectives are pursued. This includes procedural decisions, drafting and filing documents, scheduling matters, and implementing court rulings.

We will consult with you regarding significant strategic decisions and material developments. You agree to make timely decisions when requested so that your case can continue moving forward.

Failure to make timely decisions may delay your case, increase costs, or limit available options.

Professionalism & Respect          ______ (initials)

We are committed to maintaining a respectful and professional working relationship.

You agree to treat all members of THE ALLIES team with professionalism and respect.

Abusive, threatening, harassing, or disrespectful conduct toward any member of our team may result in suspension of work and withdrawal from representation, consistent with the Rules of Professional Conduct.

Misc Provisions

Conclusion of Representation

Representation concludes when:

The agreed scope of work has been completed,

A final order or judgment has been entered,

You terminate the engagement,

Or THE ALLIES withdraws consistent with ethical rules.

Upon conclusion of representation, we will notify you that your matter is closed. Representation does not include post-judgment enforcement, appeals, or modification proceedings unless separately agreed to in writing.

Storage & Retention of Legal File

We maintain all files electronically. Paper documents are scanned and securely destroyed unless you request otherwise.

You may download your file from the Client Portal during your representation and for thirty (30) days following the conclusion of your case.

We will retain a digital copy of your file for 5 years after representation ends. During that time, you may request an additional copy. Reasonable administrative fees may apply for retrieval or re-preparation of archived materials.

Attorney work product (including internal notes, impressions, and internal strategy documents) is not part of the client file and will not be released.

After the retention period, THE ALLIES may securely destroy the file without further notice.

Termination of Services

You may terminate this Agreement at any time.

If representation is terminated before completion of the agreed scope, fees will be handled in accordance with Appendix “A” and the Utah Rules of Professional Conduct.

THE ALLIES may withdraw from representation consistent with ethical rules, including but not limited to circumstances where:

You fail to pay fees as agreed.

You fail to provide required information or cooperate.

You misrepresent material facts.

You insist upon illegal or unethical conduct.

You engage in abusive, threatening, harassing, or disrespectful conduct toward any member of our team.

Continued representation would violate professional obligations.

If court approval is required for withdrawal, we will continue representation until released by the court. You remain responsible for fees and costs incurred through the date of formal withdrawal.

Dispute Resolution

If you have a concern regarding your representation, including fees or services, you agree to notify THE ALLIES in writing and allow thirty (30) days to attempt resolution.

If the dispute cannot be resolved informally, you agree to participate in mediation before initiating litigation.

Nothing in this provision limits your rights under applicable professional conduct rules.

Tax Information (W-9 Equivalent Disclosure)

This Agreement provides the firm’s legal name, address, and federal tax identification number for reporting purposes:

THE ALLIES LAW FIRM1755 N 400 ENorth Logan, UT 84341EIN: ####

If a separate IRS Form W-9 is required, it may be provided upon request. Administrative fees may apply for additional documentation requests.

Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Utah.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement, together with Appendix “A,” constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions or understandings.

No modification of this Agreement shall be valid unless in writing and signed by both parties.

I the undersigned have read this Agreement and do hereby agree to be bound by the terms herein effective as of the date below. 

Name: _______________________

Signature: ____________________

Date: ________________________
